seasons.title: SLBC Madhya Pradesh: crop season of various crops in M.P.

days_to_first_harvest.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
days_to_first_harvest.quote: average plant height of 207 cm. It matures in 80 days.
days_to_first_harvest.note: Earliest PAU variety (PCB 164); others take 88-124 days.

spacing_row_cm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
spacing_row_cm.quote: Sow the seed about 2.5 cm deep in rows 50 cm apart.

water_need.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
water_need.quote: Under rainfed conditions, apply 1/2 N and whole of P with last ploughing
water_need.note: Grown as a rainfed crop: read as 'low'. Agronomist to confirm.

expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.quote: On an average, it gives 12.8 quintals per acre of grain yield.
expected_yield_kg_per_sqm.note: A q/acre figure is converted at 4047 m² per acre: 12.8 q/acre = 0.32 kg/m². Lowest of the PAU varieties.

spacing_plant_cm.title: PAU Ludhiana: package of practices for kharif crops
spacing_plant_cm.quote: Thin the seedlings to 15 cm apart in the rows after three weeks of sowing.

source_notes: AI research batch 11 (2026-10-07). Ranges are stored at their lower bound unless a note says otherwise; the source range is in each quote. Sowing months for Madhya Pradesh come from the state crop-season table (SLBC); other values are TNAU/PAU guides (Tamil Nadu, Punjab) until a local source is found.
